summary.text: Amanda Collamore is a Republican state representative from Maine who represents District 68 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a business owner and the Republican ranking member of the House Ethics Committee.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Collamore was born in Waterville, Maine, and lives in Pittsfield, Maine.
She earned an associate degree in early childhood education from Kennebec Valley Community College in 2015 and a bachelor's degree in elementary education from the University of Maine in 2018.

Her career experience includes Collamore Management Services, Jeremy Smiles Photography, and work as program coordinator for the Transportation Infrastructure Durability Center at the University of Maine.
Collamore has served in the Maine House of Representatives since 2020, according to Ballotpedia, and won re-election to District 68 in 2022 and 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session she is the ranking member of the Ethics Committee, and in 2023-2024 she was ranking member of the Innovation, Development, Economic Advancement and Business Committee.
